mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may inhibit metabolism of tacrolimus and increase CNS effects; tacrolimus has immunosuppressive effects that could complicate MAOI therapy; potential for serotonergic interactions if tacrolimus is used with other serotonergic agents.
action: Monitor tacrolimus levels closely if combination is necessary; assess for signs of tacrolimus toxicity (tremor, renal dysfunction, hypertension); consider alternative antidepressant; caution with concurrent serotonergic agents.
